FN-RBGUHYY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 84
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Woods
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 84 as introduced would decrease the obligations of the Board of Chiropractic
Examiners by an estimated $600 per year by allowing the board to use an independent agency
other than a certified public accounting firm, as currently required by law, to conduct board
elections. This bill would further decrease the obligations of the board by an undetermined
amount by allowing the board to provide election notices and ballots electronically instead of
mailing.
